utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive too, so folks hear about it quickly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll bring my notepad and any spare tools I’ve got. That should help once I swing by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Dane — that’ll be really helpful. I’ll keep passing it around so more neighbors know to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, but I’d like the plan written down first. Once Oren has the fixes and timing clear, I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll pass along that Eli wants the plan written down first. Once Oren’s got the fixes and timing clear, I’ll keep folks updated.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell. Once Oren writes down the fixes and timing, I’ll be ready to follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Kira — I’ll keep the repair drive lined up with the school schedule and pass the word along on the block. We’ve got Tess, Leo, Mina, and Gus helping out, so it should come together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—Rosa’s still handling the sign-ups and keeping the details clear before they go out?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — Rosa’s still handling the sign-ups and keeping everything clear before it goes out. I’ll make sure it stays coordinated with the school schedule and the block.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Leo has the gloves and screwdrivers, Ira’s spreading the word, Oren’s getting everything ready, and Quinn’s still on word-duty with Pia too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then I’ll keep the supplies list on track and make sure gloves, tape, and the other tools are covered. I’ll also keep an eye on whether Pia confirms.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — thanks, Cleo. I’ll keep an eye out too and let you know if I hear anything about Pia.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a maybe—I just want the drop-off time and details confirmed first, since the logistics are a bit fuzzy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, fair — I’ll get the drop-off details and confirmed time sorted, then I’ll let you know. I’m heading by the repair drive later and I’ll check in with Noah afterward too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — once the drop-off time and details are confirmed, I can decide. Please let me know when you’ve got the logistics sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll make sure folks on the block hear about the repair drive, and I’ll keep it tied to the school schedule when I mention it. Faye’s got it organized around that, so I’ll pass it along that way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good, Tess. I’ll bring my tools and a notepad, and I’ll double-check any details before I jump in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word on the block and point folks to the school schedule. That should help keep everything lined up with Faye’s plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m bringing a box of gloves and blue masking tape. What’s already covered so Cleo can fill in the gaps?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ira’s got the word-spreading covered while she’s out on errands, and I’m making sure everything else is ready. Eli’ll follow the plan once he gets the list, so Cleo can just fill in whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, then I’ll pass that along to Cleo. Gus can bring over a few tools too, unless you’ve already got that covered.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring what I have. Hana’s got the tools and notepad covered, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Hana’s bringing the tools and a notepad. Gus is bringing his tools too, and Jules is spreading the word to line up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, that’s enough for me to remember — I’ll just bring my own tools and spread the word if I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s on Sunday at the community center, and I’d like the exact address noted down correctly. If needed, Bo can provide it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll keep asking around for a few more helpers and can help connect folks, too. If I need the exact address, I’ll check with Bo and make sure it’s noted down right.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that sounds good. Please make sure the exact address gets written down correctly for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can sort the tools and carry parts over. I’ll bring gloves and a couple screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Leo — I’ll add you to the sign-up sheet. We’re set for Sunday at the community center, and your help will make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa’s keeping the sign-up sheet ready, and I’ve got the first step set for Dane. When he comes by, I’ll let him take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll listen for any updates and pass them along. If the drop-off details and confirmed time come through, I’ll let Pia know too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I appreciate you keeping everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands. Sounds like we’re in good shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring over a few tools and lend a hand whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep letting folks know while I’m out, and we should be all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over a few tools and lend a hand whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’ll stop by the repair drive later and then check in with Noah afterward.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just swing by when you’re ready, and I’ll have the tools handy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still listening for the latest on the repair drive, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear more. If you get the drop-off details and confirmed time, that should help Pia decide.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the drop-off details and confirmed time before I act. I’m bringing my tools and a notepad, and Noah said Leo has the gloves and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s great — the drop-off details and confirmed time will really help Pia decide. I’ll keep listening for updates and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring gloves and a couple screwdrivers, and I can sort the tools and carry parts over. Just point me to the parts boxes after I finish the hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll point you to the parts boxes, and we’ve got Gus, Hana, and Jules lined up too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll start with the hand tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll confirm the drop-off time and make sure Pia has the timing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, I’ll bring my notepad and whatever spare tools I’ve got. Just let me know the drop-off time and I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane — I’ll confirm the drop-off time and send it your way as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll keep asking around for a few more helpers and spread the word too. If you hear of anyone who wants to pitch in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the drop-offs and what time they’re set for?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — I’ll confirm the drop-offs and the times, then let you know. And I’ll keep asking around for a few more volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll bring whatever tools I already have. Just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—Sunday at the community center is set, and I want to make sure the exact address is noted down correctly. If you can share it, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure of the exact address offhand, but I can check and send it over. Just keep me posted on what tools are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Faye’s got the repair drive lined up around the school schedule, so it should be easier for folks on the block to swing by. I’ll keep passing that along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along whatever I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Nell — I’ll keep tying it to the school schedule when I mention it around the block. If I hear any updates, I’ll pass them right along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Cleo’s keeping the list updated, so once we know what’s already covered, she’ll fill in the gaps. Gus can bring over a few tools for the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive while I’m out running errands. It’s good to hear Gus can bring tools too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. If you hear of anyone else who can bring supplies, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, then we’ve got Leo, Jules, and you pitching in. I’ll let Ira spread the word, keep Pia on the maybe list, and have Cleo cover any missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive. And Ira can spread the word while they’re out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — that should cover us nicely. I’ll keep Pia on standby and make sure Cleo’s ready if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll keep the sign-up sheet ready for Sunday at the community center and add any helpers we get. Just let me know when Dane swings by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll have the first step ready for Dane, and when he comes by I’ll let him take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — that’ll make it easy for Dane to jump in. I’ll keep the sheet ready and add anyone else who can help on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll keep the repair drive lined up with the school schedule, and Tess can help spread the word on the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, as long as we have the plan written down before tomorrow. Once it’s clear, I’ll follow it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll write it up tonight so it’s clear by tomorrow. We’ve got the tools, parts, and word-of-mouth covered.
